items: Host forward time does not establish GPU compute share; the 2.86% and 0.43% figures are withdrawn.
The summary used cumulative owner counters for window analysis; corrected with clock.owner_timings and clock.totals. Example attention_base_60 cumulative forward 1.613 s vs window delta 1.180 s.
The cache microbenchmark does not match the production native/compiled/B500 path, and 15% is not the current mixed-budget hit rate; no cache implementation or A/B was run.
Cache was re-measured: S128N1 ready-hit 4.905%, S256N4 16.291%, request-weighted 13.20%; GPU graph attention 16.75 us/row, MLP 4.45 us/row. Actual cache A/B still absent.

window_phase_coverage.basis: R20 full round: 94,368,896 simulations / 267,151 decisions = 353.24 sims/decision; 66.79 decisions/game
window_phase_coverage.note: early/midgame coverage only; no tail or completed games

mlp_bottleneck.conclusion: MLP is not FLOPs-bound; production graph share ~50%, CPU ~42%; owner gather/dispatch and worker supply remain the bottleneck. Graph ratio 3.47x vs FLOPs 5.82x; end-to-end 2.1x.

easy_variants.note: 20 s screening is thermally confounded; only 60 s repeats are used for conclusions. Width grouping patch was reverted.

mlp_bottleneck.caveat: production NativePackedTransfer CUDAGraph replay; B500; graph-only share excludes H2D/D2H overlap. FLOPs/sim-s/CPU/gather are direct.
